name: Human Defiler
tactics: Mindful to conceal their forbidden magic under other circumstances, defilers eagerly unleash their might in battle. They prefer to fight from a distance, but they are not averse to letting their foes come within range of their defiling trait and suffer its debilitating effect.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Staff Implement
items.description: Using a nonmagical implement confers no benefit. You can purchase a magical implement to gain an enhancement bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with your arcane powers. A staff implement can also function as a magic quarterstaff.

items.name: Spellbook
items.description: Wizards keep the spells they’ve learned in a spellbook.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Defiling
traits.details: Whenever the defiler uses an implement power, each enemy within 3 squares of it takes 5 necrotic damage.

hit.description: lightning damage, and the target is slowed and takes ongoing 10 poison damage (save ends both).

miss.description: Half damage, and the target is slowed until the end of its next turn.

powers.name: Defiling Serpent
powers.trigger: An enemy within 10 squares of the defiler spends a healing surge.

effect.description: The defiler regains a number of hit points equal to half the value of the triggering healing surge, and lightning serpent recharges.
